admission.requires: Exact variant/serial or explicit representative configuration, engine and propeller identity, wing geometry, gross weight, cooling and stores state.
Sourced shaft-power nodes per rating and gear with RPM, boost, altitude domain and source unit. Record ram, temperature and atmospheric basis. Keep boost distinct from shaft power.
Speed and climb source rows across more than one altitude. Identify fit and reserved rows before calibration and keep separate specimens or configurations explicitly labelled.
Use shared physics, expose supported metrics in the app and export with sources, preserve the four-aircraft benchmark, and pass numerical and browser checks. Mark unverified lift and turn estimates.
